threshold_rules.G0: per candidate quantity: max |q'-q| over regions x renders under k-scaling in {0.5, 2.0} (linear RGB, clip) <= EPS[q]; SAME-pixel comparison (polygon AND original gate AND scaled gate AND unclipped; kept fractions recorded; clipped pixels carry no colour and cannot test the quantity); sensitivity: +5 a* cheek copy moves hue/CdivL > SENS_MIN, +5 L* cheek copy moves logY_face/Lratio_face > SENS_MIN; drop failures; dL_face must NOT be invariant (counterexample).
threshold_rules.G1_G2: per row: threshold = midpoint(known-good delta, known-bad delta); margin = |bad-good|/2. RULE 1: row enforceable iff d_good < d_bad AND margin/noise >= 1; else report-only (inverted/tied rows: does not separate known-good from known-bad). RULE 2: gate (region x channel/quantity) enforced iff ALL its known-bad rows enforceable; gate threshold = smallest midpoint; gate margin = distance from it to the nearest delta; gate noise = max row noise. RULE 3: noise is pixel-sampling SD ONLY (margins/noise ~50-350 expected); margin_over_phys divides by the measured G0 epsilon (hue 1.5 deg etc.; G1 L uses dL 0.05; G1 a/b null, no measured epsilon). Render run-to-run adds 0 per room-rig-remeasure G0. Thresholds use known-good/known-bad ONLY; body2 evaluation numbers are computed after.

g0.rule: per candidate quantity: max |q'-q| over regions x renders under k-scaling in {0.5, 2.0} (linear RGB, clip) <= EPS[q]; SAME-pixel comparison (polygon AND original gate AND scaled gate AND unclipped; kept fractions recorded; clipped pixels carry no colour and cannot test the quantity); sensitivity: +5 a* cheek copy moves hue/CdivL > SENS_MIN, +5 L* cheek copy moves logY_face/Lratio_face > SENS_MIN; drop failures; dL_face must NOT be invariant (counterexample).
